main_text.p: mensis qvintus est illis ordine, anni qvidem Hegiræ Muhamedicæ 1031, incidisse. Tertio deniqve, vigesimam sextam diem Junii, Anni Domini 1627, à Turcis Constantinopoli duodecimam mensis, Sceuval, qvi decimus est ordine, anni eorum Hegiræ 1036, fuisse numeratam, hæc autem sunt nomina mensium Arabicorum, qvibus Muhammedani fere omnes in describendis fastis, ut ita dicam, utuntur; 1. Muharrem. 2. Sefer. 3. Rabia eleuvel vel primus. 4. Rabia ettha-ni sive secundus. 5. Gemadhi eleuvel. 6. Gemadhi etthani. 7. Regeb. 8. Scio-aban, 9. Ramadhan. 10. Sceuval. 11. Dhilcaade. 12. Dhilhagge; & hi omnes sunt lunares, sex [?]30. diebus, sex vero 29. alternatim constantes, nisi aliqva intercalatio-ad adæqvandas novilunia cum mensium principiis occurat, qvæ triginta qvolibet, sive viginti novem, ni fallor annorum spatio, undecies certo ordine apponi solet ad calcem postremi mensis, qvi tunc addita intercalari die, & ipse 30. diebus terminatur. Persæ

page.notes: The page number "223" is printed in the top right corner. The number "1031" is printed with spaces between the digits, and "1627" and "1036" likewise. The number "30" after "sex" looks like ";o" in the scan, so it is marked [?]. The words Muharrem, Rabia, Gemadhi, Regeb, Sciaban, Ramadhan, Sceuval and Dhilcaade are set in bold type in the print; the text here is plain. The hyphens at "fe-re", "ettha-ni", "Scio-aban" and "intercalatio-ad" are printed line-end hyphens, and the scan at "intercalatio" shows a dot that is read as a hyphen. "Dhilhagge" is read as printed.
